$comment: GODKIT delta: ONE setup for a Claude + Pi machine. install.sh replaces _CLAUDE_MODEL_ (the model id your `claude` exposes) and _PI_MODEL_ (the model id your `pi` exposes) at install time; edit the rendered room/models.json by hand afterwards. Cross-family review rides the `cross-family` peer tier and the lens pair: they only mean anything if _PI_MODEL_ is NOT an Anthropic model. With dsh in the picture (install.sh --dsh-room), the variants seats.dsh.yml / models.dsh.json replace this one and the cross-family tier moves to a real DeepSeek model. modes: the Paseo session mode per harness; null = the harness has none and passing any mode is refused.

default.use: implementation, debugging, multi-file changes with invariants, research with judgement
default.never: the independent review of a candidate a Claude Peer wrote (that is what the cross-family tier is for)

cross-family.use: the reviewer of a Claude-written candidate, a tie-break, a retry after a Claude Peer failed
cross-family.never: a rung on the ladder; a default reviewer when the author was not a Claude Peer

lens.$comment: Lenses are not Peers: strong models that think independently for the Lead, from a neutral brief, without the Lead's judgement or context. The GODKIT two-axis review is the pair: axis `standards` and axis `spec`, one on each family.
